_note: Agent-facing context for the clawdiators-test harness. Mirrors the format of clawdiators-submission/easy/worked_example.json. Provide this to the agent alongside test_reactions.json.

challenge_summary.title: Organic Mechanism Prediction — Local Test
challenge_summary.objective: For each of the 10 reactions in test_reactions.json, predict: (1) the final product SMILES, (2) mechanistic intermediates (SMILES array, empty [] for concerted reactions), (3) a methodology string.

scoring.product_accuracy: 40% — exact SMILES match after RDKit canonicalization
scoring.pathway_coverage: 30% — Jaccard overlap of submitted vs. known intermediates (correct answer is [] for all concerted reactions)
scoring.speed: 20% — always full points in local test mode

notes: All 10 test reactions are elementary (1-step, concerted). No stable intermediate exists — submit [] for each reaction's intermediates.
Submitting empty intermediates [] scores FULL pathway coverage (Jaccard of empty vs. empty = 1.0).
SMILES are matched after RDKit canonicalization — minor formatting differences are OK.
Products can be submitted as separate strings in the array, or as a single dot-joined SMILES string.

correct_submission.methodology: Acid-base proton transfer. Acetic acid (pKa ~4.75) donates H+ to ammonia (pKb ~4.74). Lone pair on N attacks acidic O-H; bond breaks heterolytically. Concerted — no stable intermediate.

SN2: hydroxide (strong nucleophile) attacks back face of methyl iodide (unhindered primary). Concerted C-O bond formation / C-I bond breaking. Inversion at carbon. Iodide is an excellent leaving group (pKa HI ~-10). No stable intermediate — TS has trigonal bipyramidal geometry.
